data.one_liner: Annotation for generating copyWith extensions code using copy_with_extension_gen.
data.what_it_does: Defines annotations that work with copy_with_extension_gen to automatically generate copyWith extension methods for Dart classes and record typedefs, helping to maintain immutability.
use_when: You want to generate copyWith methods for immutable classes without writing them manually
You need shallow copyWith support for annotated record typedefs
avoid_when: You prefer manual implementation of copyWith methods
You are already using a comprehensive code generation solution like freezed that includes copyWith out of the box
strengths: Automates boilerplate generation for immutable models
Supports Dart primary constructors and shallow copying for record typedefs
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and a separate generator package to produce code
Breaking changes in generator rules can require updating generated files and class configurations
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package and its generator counterpart, then running build_runner.

alternatives.name: freezed
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive solution for union types, pattern matching, and built-in copyWith generation without needing separate manual models.

alternatives.name: built_value
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers immutable value types with custom serialization and builders as an alternative to standard data classes.
